# Welcome {.unnumbered}

This tutorial introduces **OtsuFire**, an R package that implements a self-labelling framework for wall-to-wall burned-area mapping across sensors and decades.

The book guides readers through the framework step by step. The first chapter introduces OtsuFire, the gap it addresses, its two-stage workflow, and the input data it requires. The following chapters show how to use the R package, with worked examples for each stage that readers can adapt to their own data.

This is a living document. Chapters will be added and revised as the tutorial develops, so its structure reflects the current state of the OtsuFire framework.

::: {.callout-note}
The package is available on CRAN as `OtsuFire`. Installation instructions and a first worked example are provided in the *How to use the OtsuFire package* chapter.
:::
